services.desc: Exhibits highlighting and showcasing local history, heritage, and institutions have been mostly displayed in the Academy Building since 2010. Those prepared in digital format may still be viewed today. blurb: The earliest part of the Holley-Williams House was built in 1768 for the Salisbury Furnace ironmaster. The larger Classic Revival section was added in 1808 by John Milton Holley, Margaret Holley Williams’ great-grandfather.
